rules.statement: The deposit of money as security for costs in appeal must be hypothecated by a bond in accordance with the provisions of section 757 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: In a series of cases it has been held that the provisions of section 756 must be strictly complied with (see 280 Kandappen v. Elliott,1 Charles v. Jandris,2 and Gunatileke v. Punchihamy 3).
